auditor.name: Mayur Shah & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Auditor resigned on 14-02-2026 but report issued per SEBI circular; delay in signing due to non-availability of external evidences (Form 26AS, AIS/TIS); preferential allotment funds of Rs. 14.41 crore used for investments instead of working capital; confirmations for debit/credit balances not received; outstanding proposed dividend not complied with; share certificates for investments not received.

key_risks: Auditor resignation and reliance on management representations
Non-availability of external evidence (Form 26AS, AIS/TIS) for verification
Diversion of preferential allotment funds (Rs. 14.41 crore) to investments instead of working capital
Unconfirmed debit/credit balances subject to reconciliation
Lack of share certificates/demat statements for investments made
